title: Coast Guard Top Videos of 2011: Santa Barbara Rescue
description: The Coast Guard and Santa Barbara Harbor Patrol rescued a family of four, including a 6-month-old baby and a dog, after their sailboat broke free from its mooring in Santa Barbara, Calif. U.S Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 1st Class Adam Eggers. Also available in high definition.
keywords: rescue swimmer, top videos of 2011, Coast Guard, search and rescue, High Definition
